inc-bot: ALERT: meter-collector (eu1) token-delta > 8% vs baseline, multiple overage flags triggered. Auto-paging #incidents oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-03-20-045
Maya (oncall): ack, joining. :rotating_light:
Sam: any customer impact confirmed?
Ingrid (billing): yes — a small set of customers got transient overage flags starting ~02:12 UTC. Usage reports delayed and token counts inflated for emitter->aggregator path.
Carlos (SRE): checking logs now; saw spike right after deploy 1.12.3. Emitter windowing change looks suspect. Quick sample from eu1:```
TRACE abc123 | emitter_window_ms=5000 | expected_tokens=10,234 | reported_tokens=120,345
metric.service.billing.delta=+1041%
```
Maya (oncall): can we toggle the new windowing flag and route to fallback?
Jordan (ops): rolling flag now -> false for eu1. Command run: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/feature-flags/emit_window -d '{"env":"eu1","value":false}'`
inc-bot: FLAG_CHANGE executed by Jordan at 6432110222 (audit id: AUD-9876).
Carlos (SRE): after flag flip, aggregator deltas back to near-baseline in latest 30s sample. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=billing_delta&env=eu1 (shortlink)
Ingrid (billing): good — but we need to suppress/outdate any overage notifications and plan a backfill to correct counts. Creating ticket BILL-3492 to coordinate replay + billing hold.
Emily (support): notifying customers in Affected Customers list; pausing automated overage emails. Draft: "We're investigating an internal metering anomaly; billing adjustments will follow"
Sam: can we run a targeted replay for the 02:10-02:20 UTC window? How long to reconcile?
Carlos (SRE): replay queued; estimate 18-24 minutes to process backlog for eu1. We'll run validations against shadow ledger.
Jordan (ops): starting replay job: `kubectl exec -n billing replay-runner -- /app/replay --from 2026-03-20T02:10Z --to 2026-03-20T02:20Z --env eu1`
Maya (oncall): monitor logs; if any residual spikes, prepare fast rollback plan for emitter binary (tag v1.12.2).
inc-bot: RECONCILE_PROGRESS: replay job started, job_id replay-6432110300.
Carlos (SRE): validation checks passing for first 50% of batches. Token delta reduces to within 2% window.
Ingrid (billing): hold lifted on automated customer notifications (we delayed emails). We'll send an update after backfill completes.
Emily (support): sent interim customer note to affected accounts.
Sam: thanks everyone. Please update BILL-3492 with timestamps and final numbers.
Jordan (ops): post-incident, I'll add a toggle test to the deploy job and add a canary gate to the emitter window change.
Maya (oncall): monitoring. If stable for 30m we close page. Great coordination — follow-up runbook + postmortem to assigned on BILL-3492. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-03-20-045 status -> monitoring. Last update 6432110567."
